title: feat(breadcrumb): implement panel on breadcrumb (panel: part 1)
body:
This PR implements the panel options for the breadcrumb.

This is the first sub-part of the [panel stacked PR](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2961). (the stack is a bit weird here, since there is a commit on the main branch that also contains part of it)
